name: Speculum
source:
The federals found videos containing horrific footage of the aftermath of the SPECULUM project, which was founded back in 1983 and was headed by Walter Flores. Everyone forgot about this project a long time ago, many even considered it a myth, but the horror made itself felt again.

[Translated from [url=https://yamooori.itch.io/project-speculum]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
联邦政府发现了包含SPECULUM项目后果的可怕镜头的视频，该项目成立于1983年，由沃尔特·弗洛雷斯 (Walter Flores) 领导。每个人都早已忘记了这个项目，许多人甚至认为它是一个神话，但恐怖再次袭来。

[译自[url=https://yamooori.itch.io/project-speculum]itch.io[/url]]
